issue.title: tests/test_file_panel.py: 6 tests still assert panel.update.called after the scroll-anchor refactor routed every body render through _update_body
issue.description:
Six tests in tests/test_file_panel.py fail deterministically on clean master, unrelated to any in-flight diff: test_render_static_file_result_renders_content, test_display_linked_diff_renders_banner_and_raw_content, test_live_diff_renders_all_lines_and_posts_line_count, test_live_diff_timestamp_refresh_reuses_cached_body, test_file_panel_pathological_cap_posts_explicit_range, and test_linked_diff_full_rerender_keeps_banner.

Reproduction: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_file_panel.py -q -p no:randomly' -> 6 failed, 11 passed. Verified on a clean stashed tree at master ce1ad41a1 and again after rebasing onto master e93da1e91, so it is not workspace- or diff-specific and is not a parallel-lane flake. Also surfaced as 6 of the 7 failures in a full 'just test' run (31307 passed, 7 failed); the 7th is the separate stats-golden drift already noted on the feature-flags epic.

Failure shape: 'assert panel.update.called' -> AssertionError: assert False, where panel is the test's MagicMock body widget (tests/test_file_panel.py:243 for the static-file case).

Root cause: commit ce1ad41a1 'fix(ace): stop the file panel from losing the reader's scroll position' (tale plan 202608/file_panel_scroll_anchor.md) replaced the ad-hoc save/restore calls with a scroll-anchor controller, so every body render now funnels through the new _update_body seam in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/file_panel/_content.py rather than calling body.update() directly. The tests were not updated and still assert on the old direct-update call.

Scope: update the six assertions to observe the current _update_body seam (or have the mock body satisfy it), preserving what each test actually guards -- rendered content, the linked-diff banner, the live-diff line-count message, cached-body reuse on timestamp refresh, and the pathological-cap explicit range message. Do not weaken the assertions to mere 'was called' checks on a seam that no longer proves content reached the widget, and do not change production behavior: the scroll-anchor routing is the intended fix.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced by sase-m9.land post-close verification on a NEWER tree than the original report: master ccbcb3557 (the sase-m9 integration commit, two commits past the e93da1e91 rebase cited in the description). Exhaustive lane 'just test' (monitor k8tezynyarfn, 8m31s): 7 failed, 31353 passed, 10 skipped. Six of the seven are exactly this bead's nodes; the seventh is the separate sase-nb stats-golden drift. Isolated rerun '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_file_panel.py -p no:randomly -q' -> 6 failed, 11 passed, confirming deterministic and not a parallel-lane flake. Confirms the stated root cause by reading source: _update_body at src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/file_panel/_content.py:136 does call self.update(renderable), and all 8 render sites in _display.py now route through it, so PRODUCTION IS CORRECT -- the defect is test-only. ce1ad41a1 changed _display.py but updated only tests/ace/tui/widgets/file_panel/* and tests/ace/tui/test_agents_zoom_panel_files.py, leaving tests/test_file_panel.py stale; its _make_render_panel() MagicMock records panel._update_body and never reaches panel.update. Not attributable to epic sase-m9. Full log: sase monitor show k8tezynyarfn --all-lines

Independently reproduced running just test-scoped for an unrelated change (restoring Gemini 3.7 Flash High to @xsmall only, plan restore_gemini_xsmall_only.md). Same 6 tests fail identically; confirmed pre-existing by reproducing on clean master via git stash.

Proposed by phase beads sase-n4.5.1, sase-n4.5.2, and sase-n4.5.3; independently reproduced during sase-n4.5 landing on master eba0eab7 after just install. Serial tests/test_file_panel.py fails at test_render_static_file_result_renders_content with panel.update.called false, matching sase-nk root cause and scope.

Independent reproduction while landing epic sase-na (proposed as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP by phase beads sase-na.3 and sase-na.4). On master eba0eab73 in workspace sase_12 after a from-scratch 'just install': '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_file_panel.py -q -p no:randomly' -> 6 failed, 74 passed (run also included test_bead/test_cli_golden.py, test_logs_pane.py, test_config_init_handler.py, test_var_integration.py, all passing). Exactly the six nodes named in the description fail, so this is still live 2h after filing and is not diff-specific: my tree touched only prompt-history word indexing, completion-row rendering, and docs. Note that the other failures reported alongside these six by sase-na.2/.3/.4 have since been fixed -- test_bead_cli_golden_contract[stats] (extra 'Flags: 0' line), test_var_integration schema_version 22-vs-21, test_logs_pane G/shift-G, and test_config_init_handler all pass now -- so these six are the sole remaining survivors of that cluster.

Independently reproduced on clean master 630f4ea71 in workspace sase_22 while implementing an unrelated plan (finalizer_staged_bead_state). Same 6 tests failed via 'just test-scoped' scoped lane and confirmed via git stash on a clean checkout: test_render_static_file_result_renders_content, test_display_linked_diff_renders_banner_and_raw_content, test_live_diff_renders_all_lines_and_posts_line_count, test_live_diff_timestamp_refresh_reuses_cached_body, test_file_panel_pathological_cap_posts_explicit_range, test_linked_diff_full_rerender_keeps_banner.
